dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast, jagged light-colored perimeters and medium-grey interior gradients, most prominent in the mid-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Clusters of localized high-intensity white pixels are concentrated along the dorsal midline and in the interstices of the larger annular patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship defined by an obtuse triangle formed by the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central lateral zone.

other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, non-repeating reticulated texture patterns forming a dense network of light-colored lines across the dorsal-lateral surface.
